name: ZINC20
description: A sample from the ZINC20 database (sourced from HuggingFace zpn/zinc20, ~1B molecules total). Contains purchasable, drug-like compounds with SMILES, SELFIES representations, and ZINC IDs. Intended as a lightweight reference dataset for development, testing, and benchmarking. For the full dataset see https://huggingface.co/datasets/zpn/zinc20

data_schema.title: ZINC20 Molecule Record
data_schema.description: One row of the ZINC20 TSV sample — a single purchasable, drug-like molecule.

smiles.description: Canonical SMILES string for the molecule.

selfies.description: SELFIES (SELF-referencing Embedded Strings) representation of the molecule.

metadata.citation: Irwin, J.J., Tang, K.G., Young, J. et al. ZINC20 — A Free Ultralarge-Scale Chemical Database for Ligand Discovery. J. Chem. Inf. Model. 2020, 60, 12, 6065-6073.
